name: io.github.Enigmacker/mcp-authprobe
title: mcp-authprobe
description: Active OAuth tests for remote MCP servers you own: tokens, PKCE, redirect_uri, audience, CSRF.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the ownership secret (create it with `mcp-authprobe ownership init <host>`). Without a secret, only discovery runs.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Ownership secret, if not read from MCP_AUTHPROBE_SECRET_FILE.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a test grant written by `mcp-authprobe login`, for the refresh token checks. The full sequence consumes it; a grant that stays valid is rewritten with the newest refresh token.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_ALLOW_PRIVATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow a loopback or private address for the scanned host (local labs only).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_LAB_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated lab origins exempt from the ownership proof, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080 (the exact origin, not the whole loopback).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a static API key (one line, mode 600) for a server authenticated without OAuth. Needs MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_TARGET.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: The exact MCP URL the static key or access token may be used for.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_HEADER
environmentVariables.description: Header for the static key (default Authorization, sent as Bearer).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to an OAuth access token (one line, mode 600) instead of a static key. Needs MCP_AUTHPROBE_BEARER_TARGET.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: A pre-registered OAuth client (or client ID metadata document URL) for servers without dynamic client registration.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_CLIENT_SECRET_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to that client's secret, for a confidential client.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_REDIRECT_URI
environmentVariables.description: One of that client's registered redirect URIs, for the redirect URI checks.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: legacy (MCP 2025-11-25) or modern (2026-07-28), instead of detecting the revision.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_ALLOWED_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated list of the only hosts the scan tool accepts.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTHPROBE_ALLOW_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: With MCP_AUTHPROBE_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1, other hosts that may be on a private address (an authorization server of a lab).
